sources.snippet: KraftMaid rated Price Level 4 Quality B+ Value A- for standard line. B+ A for Vantage. Higher-value semi-custom at PL4 but quality capped at B+ without plywood upgrade. Confirms Fabuwood at PL2 receives A/A at lower cost. You must upgrade BOTH Integrity and Kraftmaid to all plywood construction to equal the construction quality of the two less expensive imported brands.
sources.classification_reason: Primary independent professional rating source. Direct comparative analysis with competitors.

sources.source_name: Cardinal Home Center — KraftMaid Dealer Spec
sources.snippet: Standard specification 1/2 inch panels on top and bottom of all wall cabinets and all base cabinets bottom and end panels. Explicitly notes all plywood construction is an available upgrade. Confirms standard material is engineered wood furniture board not plywood at 1/2 inch thickness.
sources.classification_reason: Authorized dealer specification confirming standard box substrate is not plywood.

sources.snippet: Drawer box 3/4 inch solid hardwood dovetail all four corners 3/16 inch captured plywood bottom 4 inch side height. Blum Whisper Touch SureMount hinges tested to 200,000 cycles 6-way adjustability. Blum undermount slides 90 lb load 100,000 cycles. 14-step oven-cured catalyzed finish DuraKraft Plus system. I-beam base support tested to 2,500 lbs. Wall cabinets 600 lbs static. 3/8 inch captured wall back. Plywood MDF and particle board used in box panels must hold screws to 190 lbs pulling force.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer quality specification document. Primary source for construction specs, hardware ratings, and testing data.

sources.source_name: MLKD — Which Cabinet Brand is Best
sources.snippet: KraftMaid the best made cabinet brand offered at both Lowes and Home Depot consistently does poorly in Consumer Reports and JD Power reports. McAlary attributes this to higher expectations of consumers buying big-box top brand. Confirms KraftMaid uses Blum soft close tracks and hinges. Emphatic that well-made framed cabinet is much more durable and will last almost forever.
sources.classification_reason: Professional analysis of KraftMaid market positioning and construction quality from most-cited independent source.

sources.snippet: Nearly every cabinet manufacturer constructs their cabinet boxes using MDF or particle board. With KraftMaid Vantage your cabinet boxes will be significantly more durable stronger sturdier and less likely to receive water damage. By emphasizing Vantage plywood as differentiator implicitly confirms standard line ships with particle board boxes.
sources.classification_reason: Authorized dealer statement that implicitly confirms standard box is particleboard by positioning plywood as Vantage upgrade differentiator.

sources.snippet: Lifetime Limited Warranty issued by Cabinetworks Group Michigan LLC for original consumer purchaser. NOT transferable under standard core warranty. Explicitly excludes labor costs for uninstalling or reinstalling. Excludes natural aging, wear and tear, misuse, non-residential use, thermofoil damage from tobacco smoke. Cabinets purchased prior to 1998 not covered.
sources.classification_reason: Warranty terms for buyer assessment. Non-transferability and labor exclusion are significant report findings.

sources.snippet: KraftMaid Reserve dealer line carries Transferable Lifetime Limited Warranty with one-time transfer to subsequent owner. Transferee must register online within 90 days. If cabinets relocated after transfer warranty no longer applies.
sources.classification_reason: Dealer-line warranty distinction. Relevant context for specification but does not apply to standard core line being scored.

sources.snippet: KraftMaid Merillat and Cabinetworks Group resigned from KCMA in October 2022 over dispute regarding anti-circumvention enforcement against Chinese cabinets transshipped through Vietnam and Malaysia. KraftMaid no longer carries current KCMA A161.1 certification. Cabinetworks states products still meet or exceed A161.1 standards.
sources.classification_reason: KCMA certification absence is verifiable and affects scoring per methodology rules. Self-certification claim is not equivalent to third-party verification.

sources.snippet: Three manufacturing facility closures in 2024. Marshall Texas July 2024 350 workers. Jefferson Texas July 2024 same announcement. Thompsontown Pennsylvania December 2024 420 workers largest employer in Juniata County. Driven by multi-family housing decline per Cabinetworks. Company down from 14-15 to 13 active facilities.
sources.classification_reason: Corporate contraction data. Relevant to outlook assessment and warranty viability, not direct product quality scoring.

sources.snippet: Platinum Equity acquired Cabinetworks Group May 2021. Q4 2021 adjusted EBITDA fell approximately 50 percent year-over-year due to inflation in raw materials. 2023 refinancing process failed. Platinum committed 400M in additional equity with lenders not supporting the deal.
sources.classification_reason: PE financial pressure data. Relevant to Corporate Risk outlook assessment, not direct quality scoring.

sources.source_name: Fine Homebuilding Forum — Cabinet Quality Discussion
sources.snippet: Professionals describe KraftMaid as good cabinets but that is big box stuff. Acknowledgment of quality hardware but standard box limitations. Framed construction praised by multiple professionals.
sources.classification_reason: Professional installer assessment in trade forum context.

sources.source_name: Houzz and BBB — KraftMaid Warranty Claims
sources.snippet: Multiple documented cases show KraftMaid denying warranty claims by attributing paint peeling to moisture damage or improper installation. Lack of labor cost coverage means even successful warranty claims require homeowners to bear reinstallation costs exceeding replacement cabinet value.
sources.classification_reason: Documented warranty claim denial patterns. Corroborated across multiple consumer reporting platforms.

sources.snippet: One documented homeowner case received 13 damaged doors out of 26 in single delivery. Shipping damage is consistent secondary complaint category in KraftMaid field data.
sources.classification_reason: Documented delivery damage incident. Recurring complaint pattern corroborated by multiple sources.

sources.snippet: KraftMaid frequently compared to Fabuwood with professionals noting Fabuwood delivers equivalent or better construction at lower price with plywood standard. Multiple users report particle board swelling around dishwasher and sink base in 5-10 year timeframe.
sources.classification_reason: Professional and consumer forum data with specific long-term durability observations.

sources.snippet: Paint peeling occurs when finish cracks at cope-and-stick door joints then moisture penetrates and lifts finish from beneath. This is inherent limitation of painted wood door construction industry-wide not KraftMaid-specific defect. MLKD confirms all painted cabinets have this issue.
sources.classification_reason: Industry-wide painted finish limitation. Context for report, not a brand-specific scoring penalty.

bottom_line: MasterBrand/Fortune Brands. Dominant semi-custom. Particleboard box (furniture-board grade). Blum hinges and slides (lower-spec than custom). Catalyzed CV finish. J.D. Power #2 satisfaction. B+ quality per Main Line. Pros specify for mid-range remodels. Platform sharing with Diamond/Merillat but KraftMaid gets better hardware.
platform_disclosure: MasterBrand Cabinets (Fortune Brands): KraftMaid, Diamond, Merillat, Decora, Omega, Aristockraft, Homecrest share factories. Higher lines get better hardware and materials from same plants.
